details: The White House is expected to host crypto and prediction market executives on August 19, 2026, to discuss the regulation of crypto assets, artificial intelligence, and prediction markets. This meeting highlights an innovation-friendly approach from regulators under the current administration.
title: White House to Host Key Meeting on Digital Asset Policy

details: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has released its 2026 Regulatory Agenda, which notably emphasizes crypto, capital formation, and retail access to private markets. The agenda includes 36 items in the proposed rule stage. Additionally, the SEC announced a roundtable for September 17, 2026, to discuss moving towards 24-hour trading in US equity markets, a development with potential implications for crypto markets.
title: SEC Releases 2026 Regulatory Agenda with Focus on Crypto

details: A crypto firm associated with Donald Trump is supporting a venture that offers artificial intelligence services from companies restricted by the US. This collaboration raises questions about potential tensions with a "China-hawk" administration, but some argue it aligns with a business-first approach.
title: Trump Crypto Firm Backs AI Venture with Restricted Chinese Companies
